title: Lightly Browned Italian Mincemeat Bigoli
description: A quick and flavorful Italian dish featuring mincemeat and bigoli pasta, served in a stone bowl and suitable for kosher diets.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the bigoli pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the mincemeat to the skillet, stirring to combine with the onion and garlic mixture, and cook until lightly browned.
Drain the cooked bigoli pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the mincemeat mixture.
Season the pasta with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the bigoli pasta to a stone bowl and top with grated parmesan cheese and chopped fresh parsley.
